item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. It's a small habit that quietly holds up everything else you're working on. Your day has plenty of reminders, but none of them is about this. Tie your dose to something you already do without fail, like your morning meditation. If you ever notice side effects or want to change a dose, bring that to your prescriber. Don't adjust it on your own. Action: set a recurring alarm labeled with your dose, right now.
